assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with AB horizontal, the angle 30 degrees marked at A and P the midpoint of AC; the segment PB makes the marked angle BPC of 45 degrees; H is the foot of the dashed perpendicular from C to AB (right angle marked), lying between A and B, and the dashed segment PH completes triangle PHC.

difficulty_rationale: Dropping the perpendicular from C to use the 30 degree angle is the key unstated step; it reveals an equilateral and an isosceles triangle, after which the angle chase is short.
